newsitem.title: USA: IMC files for up to $160 mln in securities.
newsitem.headline: IMC files for up to $160 mln in securities.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said Monday it filed a statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to register up to $160 million in securities.
The company said unless specified, any proceeds would be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, repayment or refinancing of debt, future acquisitions or capital expenditures.

"While we have no immediate plans to issue either debt or equity, this registration statement, when effective, will increase our financial flexibility and allow us to utilize the public markets to achieve our goal of minimizing our cost of capital," IMC chairman and chief executive Wendell Bueche said in a statement.

IMC said this registration, together with one filed in 1993, would permit the company to sell up to a total of $300 million in debt securities, debt warrants, preferred stock, common stock stock warrants and currency warrants.
